source.title: Channel 4 makes TV history with Britain's first AI presenter
source.source_identity_requirement: The final URL, one visible h1, one visible publication date, and selected source paragraphs must match this plan before any screenshot is retained.

collection.allow_images: Only same-publisher image requests referenced by an accessible Channel 4 logo element inside the visible site header; every other image is blocked.

claims.spoken_claim: The programme's own presenter appeared throughout reporting from different locations and was entirely AI-generated.
required_source_phrases: appears throughout reporting from different locations

claims.spoken_claim: The programme was Will AI Take My Job?
required_source_phrases: Dispatches investigates how AI automation is reshaping the workplace

claims.spoken_claim: The presenter's face, voice and movements were made with AI, without a single frame of real-world filming.
required_source_phrases: their face, voice and movements all created through AI technology
without a single frame of real-world filming

claims.spoken_claim: The presenter said: Some of you might have guessed: I don't exist, I wasn't on location reporting this story.
required_source_phrases: Some of you might have guessed: I don't exist, I wasn't on location reporting this story.

claims.spoken_claim: The presenter said: Because I'm not real.
Channel 4 did it on purpose as a deliberate stunt.
required_source_phrases: as part of a deliberate on-screen stunt to show just how convincing artificial intelligence has become

claims.spoken_claim: Louisa Compton said it showed how easy it is to hoodwink audiences with content they cannot verify.
required_source_phrases: how easy it is to hoodwink audiences with content they have no way of verifying

claims.spoken_claim: Louisa Compton was Channel 4's head of news.

asset_policy.header: Capture the unchanged native page header with its real Channel 4 mark. The mark may appear only inside the source evidence pane in the later composition; no standalone or re-drawn logo.
asset_policy.title_and_date: Capture the live page's actual h1 and date element, not a typeset reconstruction.
asset_policy.claim_paragraphs: Capture the live page's actual DOM paragraph containing each required phrase. Never synthesize a document or use saved source text as a graphic.
asset_policy.rights_status: NOT_ASSESSED; a root/editorial reviewer must inspect every source crop and determine the exact fair-dealing basis and placement before use.
